description.zh: 如果一个模型足够大、训练数据足够多，它会涌现出什么样的能力？苏茨克维教授是辛顿的学生，也是AlexNet的共同创造者。他将带你见证从GPT到GPT-4的进化历程，理解缩放定律为什么如此重要，思维链推理如何让模型学会「展示思考过程」，以及语言模型的幻觉问题揭示了哪些深层的认知边界。
description.en: If a model is large enough with enough training data, what abilities will emerge? Prof. Sutskever — Hinton's student and co-creator of AlexNet — will guide you through the evolution from GPT to GPT-4, explain why scaling laws matter so much, how chain-of-thought reasoning teaches models to 「show their work, and what the hallucination problem reveals about deep cognitive boundaries.

description.zh: 理解生成式预训练（GPT）和掩码语言模型（BERT）两种范式
description.en: Understand the generative pre-training (GPT) and masked language model (BERT) paradigms

description.zh: 理解缩放定律和大模型的涌现能力
description.en: Understand scaling laws and emergent abilities of large models

description.zh: 掌握思维链推理的原理及其对模型能力的提升
description.en: Master chain-of-thought reasoning and how it enhances model capabilities

description.zh: 理解大语言模型的幻觉问题及其认知边界
description.en: Understand the hallucination problem in LLMs and their cognitive boundaries
